case_selection: R0 construction families with variants 0/1/2 and entirely renamed entities; new canonical hashes; same cases for both models/modes
answers: Greedy 32-token native answer; typed logits at the same native answer prefix and an additional Answer-newline prefix. Fixed A=True/B=False/C=Unknown, no order sweep.
gate: Native generated answers and cue-typed decisions must each have >=90% accuracy in every nominal-depth/label/polarity cell; >=90% of thinking cases must close naturally. Invalid/capped rows count wrong.
large_trigger: Run 1.7B in both modes if either 0.6B mode fails its gate. Skip if both pass. Never expand beyond this one larger checkpoint.
reference_gate: Three fixed R0 natural-label prompts, one per gold class: fresh stock loader/generate must reproduce all greedy token IDs from R0; first-step full logits agree with legacy Scorer to <=0.001. Stop and diagnose any discrepancy.
feasibility: One model resident at a time; batch1; maximum total context 4096; stop on memory failure, no automatic quantization or model substitution.
limits: Small diagnostic, single reasoning seed, no depth-generalization or recurrence claim; cannot attribute mode plus decoding-policy changes purely to compute. Fixed token cap is not a claim of sufficient reasoning time.
